title: Report after leveling
prompt: Members `level` at 1 and `max_health` at 100, with a working `level_up`. After one level-up the robot reports itself through a `report` helper: the level on one line, then the maximum health.
starter:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func run():
	pass

func level_up():
	level += 1
	max_health *= 2

tests.name: Level is printed, then max health

hints: report prints level, then max_health; run calls level_up, then report. report reads the members after the change.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

solution:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func run():
	level_up()
	report()

func level_up():
	level += 1
	max_health *= 2

func report():
	print(level)
	print(max_health)
